text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Feelings alone aren't enough to win. 
Reality is harsh indeed..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...That said. I have no intention of 
giving up either.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If I falter here, I'll never be able to 
serve as a role model for the children!
choice_data_list: Let's not rush and just keep at it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If I falter here, I'll never be able to

choice_data_list: Let's not rush and just keep at it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even if we lose, what matters is 
working hard and clawing our way back up.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Steady, persistent accumulation will 
surely lead to great results!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I will firmly show them in the next race 
that this is how a true role model should 
act!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"If you have time to hang your head, you 
should face forward and retrain yourself, 
sir!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Boss, let's get right to it! 
Please train me strictly and thoroughly!
